overview.text: Today's key developments highlight progress across self-improving multimodal architectures, efficient video and vision generation, agentic environments, and real-world security analysis. In recursive self-improvement, A-RSI introduces adaptive task refresh for zero-data multimodal training. For efficiency, A-RSI and certificate-guided visual routing in diffusion vision-language models target redundant decoding computation. In video and generation, WeVisCut addresses long-form editing from narration, while IntReal provides a benchmark for multimodal interleaved generation. WebAnything advances reproducible training environments for web agents by moving beyond manual mirrors. Meanwhile, analysis from Epoch AI shows GLM 5.3 can transform published security fixes into working exploits, and new releases like facebook/sam3 and XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B offer updated foundation models for practitioners.

entries.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
entries.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful.
entries.why: Provides a zero-data multimodal self-improvement approach addressing when training experience stops being useful.

entries.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
entries.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image.
entries.why: Addresses redundant decoding computation in diffusion vision-language models via certificate-guided visual routing.

entries.title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
entries.summary: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear.
entries.why: Tackles the quality-cost trade-off of compact policies for long-form video editing from narration.

entries.title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
entries.summary: Humans routinely consume multimodal content, where textual and visual information is naturally interleaved. Although Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) can jointly generate text and images, multimodal interleaved generation remains largely underexplored.
entries.why: Introduces a dataset and benchmark for underexplored multimodal interleaved generation in unified models.

entries.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
entries.summary: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites.
entries.why: Solves environment construction challenges for reproducible web agent training and evaluation.

entries.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
entries.summary: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement.
entries.why: Improves detail rendering for one-step and few-step text-to-image generation under limited refinement.

entries.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
entries.summary: Financial agents must form forecasts and investment judgments from decision-time evidence, with predictions evaluated against subsequent outcomes.
entries.why: Evaluates financial agents on decision-time evidence without relying on future knowledge.

entries.title: facebook/sam3
entries.why: Offers a new mask-generation transformer model release for computer vision tasks.

entries.title: XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B
entries.why: Delivers a new text-generation transformer model for downstream application builders.

entries.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-OCR-1.0
entries.why: Provides a new image-text-to-text model for optical character recognition workflows.

entries.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
entries.summary: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.
entries.why: Highlights practical enterprise legal AI deployment for transactional document diligence.

entries.title: Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #97
entries.summary: Host Sowbhagya Suresh shares some of the latest news and cutting-edge research from across Microsoft—from understanding the challenges facing coding agents to uncovering how people use AI at work and improving extended-range weather forecasting.
entries.why: Surveys recent research directions from coding agents to extended-range weather forecasting.

entries.title: AI can turn security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
entries.summary: GLM 5.3 turned published-but-unshipped Firefox security fixes into working one-click exploits for six releases, at roughly $1,000 each.
entries.why: Demonstrates security risks where models turn published fixes into working exploits before updates.

entries.title: API credits benefit for eligible ChatGPT subscriptions
entries.summary: API credits benefit for eligible ChatGPT subscriptions Earlier this month Anthropic announced a generous new benefit for their Max and Team subscriptions: $100, $200, and $500 per month subscribers would get the equivalent quantity of (expiring) credits to use with the Anthropic…
entries.why: Covers subscription API credit updates for eligible developer workflows.

entries.title: Building Reasoning Models from the Ground Up: A Full Video Course
entries.summary: Over 11 hours of coding videos on evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation, with Python and PyTorch.
entries.why: Provides comprehensive video instruction on building reasoning models using Python and PyTorch.
